operations.old: The target makes a Wisdom save. Success: no new overlay. Failure: snapshot your actual current alignment orientation. For each axis defined both for you and for the target, compute one step toward your snapshotted value along Lawful–Neutral–Chaotic and Good–Neutral–Evil. Compute the target baseline without any previous Alignment Suggestion overlay on that target, retaining all independent actual alignment effects/records. An already matching or undefined axis gains no changed-value overlay. If at least one axis changes, replace the prior same-spell overlay with the new recorded axis values/deadline. A failed-save cast that changes no defined axis creates no new overlay and does not itself replace a valid older one; mandatory concentration transitions remain independent.

operations.old: **Alignment Suggestion:** calculate each new one-step shift with all prior same-spell overlays ignored, retaining independent actual alignment changes. Only changed defined axes receive fixed overlay values. A no-change result creates no replacement; the caster's already-required concentration transition still occurs and never resurrects an old application. A valid changed-axis application replaces the previous same-spell application; replaced concentration maintains no remaining effect. Ending exposes the then-current underlying alignment, not a historical snapshot. No conduct, belief or oathbreaking is compelled.
operations.replacement: **Alignment Suggestion:** calculate each new one-step shift with all prior same-spell overlays ignored, retaining independent actual alignment changes. Only changed defined axes receive fixed overlay values. A no-change result creates no replacement; the caster's already-required concentration transition still occurs and never resurrects an old application. A valid changed-axis application replaces the previous same-spell application; replaced concentration maintains no remaining effect. Ending exposes the then-current underlying alignment, not a historical snapshot. No conduct, belief or oathbreaking is compelled. NEW DI7 AP-AS-01 adds one named exception only: when computing a new Alignment Suggestion target baseline, exclude all Alignment Purge overlays as well as previous Suggestion overlays, retaining all other independent actual changes. Purge supplies Neutral/Neutral after live Suggestion values for effective-alignment reads, without deleting or pausing them. The caster orientation remains its actual effective snapshot, including any operative Purge on the caster. Preserve the original paragraph and reviewed card as historical evidence; no other spell or alignment effect inherits this exception.
